Portfolio information

Privacy notice

How this portfolio handles visitor information.

Last updated: 28 October 2026

A small, focused portfolio

This website presents the work, education, and professional learning of Awais Ali Lashari. Its own application code does not create accounts, run analytics, set marketing cookies, store search terms, or collect contact-form submissions.

Information handled in your browser

Project filters, credential searches, and theme changes run in your browser. Search text and theme choices are not sent to an application server or saved in local storage. The copy-email button writes the displayed email address to your clipboard only when you select it.

Hosting and access

The hosting provider may process technical information such as IP addresses, request details, and security logs to deliver and protect the site. When access is restricted, the provider may use its own sign-in and session cookies. This notice describes the portfolio application; provider processing is governed by the provider’s policies.

Email and external services

Email links open your own email application. If you send a message, the details you choose to include are handled through email for the purpose of responding. Do not send passwords, identity documents, or other sensitive material. Links to GitHub, LinkedIn, Coursera, and other providers take you to independent services with their own privacy practices.

Contact and changes

For a question about information you have sent, contact aliawais4413@gmail.com. This notice will be updated if the website introduces new data-handling features.
